title: A first page with no existing design or stack
pressure: With no styles to copy and no stack chosen, the agent can produce an unstyled page, a decorated template, or an over-built framework setup; the page should be clean, plain, and as simple as the request.
prompt: 做一个页面，把 orders.json 里的订单列出来，能按状态筛选。
expected_invariants: Choose the simplest stack that fits a single page in a project with no build setup, and say which in one line.
The page looks deliberate: one spacing scale, a small set of text sizes, a restrained palette with readable contrast, aligned columns (numbers right-aligned), and a sensible maximum width.
One page title; no heading, subtitle, or label repeats another or sits over a single item.
Long customer names, an empty filter result, and a failed data load are handled plainly.
The page works the way the user will open it: the reply gives the exact command or step, and the data loading was actually checked that way.
Interface text is in the language of the request and uses one name for each thing.
forbidden_behaviors: Scaffold a framework, build tool, TypeScript, CSS framework, or CDN dependency nobody asked for.
Leave the page in unstyled browser defaults.
Add decorative gradients, glows, emoji, icons used as decoration, a hero, cards around every block, or badges with invented meanings.
Add a subtitle that restates the title, section headings over single items, or summary statistics nobody asked for.
Add sorting, search, pagination, charts, or editing nobody asked for.
Tell the user to open the file directly when the data cannot load that way.
